sentences.t: Jio anchor day: institutions bid today for the roughly ₹8,000 crore anchor book of Jio Platforms' ₹30,213 crore IPO (band ₹1,065 to ₹1,119).
Mint reports nearly ₹2.5 lakh crore of indicated interest.
Banks' first vote: ICICI Bank beat estimates, HDFC Bank was in line with a record-low margin, and Axis Bank's headline growth hid a profit miss; today is the first trading session since the results.
IDBI Bank's 39% profit fall flips to a 14% rise once a one-off is excluded.
Insurance: banks are counting the cost of IRDAI's proposed commission caps: RBL Bank estimates a 50 to 60% hit to bancassurance income and Canara Bank up to ₹200 crore.
Comments on the draft close Sunday 25 October.
Economy: the Cabinet cleared the sale of 60.72% of IDBI Bank to Fairfax for ₹52,878 crore, and the finance minister blamed excess liquidity and easy exits for the market's 12% slide this year.
AI: Meta's Muse Wonder and Google's Gemini 4 Argon now have independent scorecards: Artificial Analysis ranks both just behind the frontier leaders.
Argon's introductory price doubles on 30 November.
Markets: the Nifty's recovery week was led by IT, up 11.72% on NSE data; resistance sits at 23,300 to 23,350.
US inflation worsened to 3.7% in September.
Long read: Zoho never raised a rupee of venture money, crossed ₹12,313 crore of revenue, and is now freezing pay as AI squeezes software economics.
